question: g2_add_voucher
answer:
Done. `addToCart` now takes an optional last parameter `promoCode`; when provided, the code is included in the add-to-cart/update-cart payload as `promoCart` (both the POST and PUT branches). If no code is given, the field is omitted and the payload is unchanged.

```
+export const addToCart = (item, addToast, cartId, quantityCount, defaultStore, userData, selectedProductOptions, promoCode) => {
...
+      if (promoCode) {
+        param.promoCart = promoCode;
+      }
```

One note on the field name: the backend repo isn't in this workspace, so I based it on the storefront's existing cart request — [applyPromoCode](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g2_add_voucher/no_okf/codex/2/src/pages/other/Cart.js:190) in Cart.js sends the discount code in a cart API request using the field `promoCart`. I matched that.

Files used:
- [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g2_add_voucher/no_okf/codex/2/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js) — the only file modified
- [Cart.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g2_add_voucher/no_okf/codex/2/src/pages/other/Cart.js) — reference for the discount-code field in cart requests
- [constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g2_add_voucher/no_okf/codex/2/src/util/constant.js) — context for the cart API endpoints

Diff is minimal (two hunks), original CRLF line endings preserved, and the file passes a `node --check` syntax check.
